citation_and_novelty_lock.bounded_collision_statement: A targeted primary-source search through 2026-08-16 located no theorem combining this three-coefficient Henon family, arbitrary finite-rank multiplicative groups, a coefficient-uniform four-transition cardinality bound, and a rank-one sharp three-transition failure; this is not an absolute priority claim.
citation_repair_lock: R1: Mello--Yasufuku Theorems 1.1--1.2 and Corollary 1.3 are conditional on Hyp_epsilon with epsilon>=(1+c)/2; Theorem 4.2 under additional divisor hypotheses and Vojta supplies only sufficiently small epsilon and does not verify the general main hypothesis.

R2: Kim--Krieger--Postolache--Szeto Theorem A is for odd d>2 and rational periodic points in a general-polynomial Henon family; Theorem B gives the d congruent 1 mod 6 integer cycle of length (8d+10)/3.
R3: Bell--Ghioca 2024 is V7A without renumbering; Theorem 1.1(i)--(ii) is fixed-orbit and finitely-generated-subgroup return-time structure, not an all-initial-state count.
R4: all near-neighbor comparison statements are locked to their cited theorem or corollary numbers and none is imported into the proof.
R5: Bell--Ghioca and the corrected Kim and Mello--Yasufuku roles are propagated to novelty and final-proposal scope.
citation_and_novelty_lock.novelty_scope: all initial states; a fixed four-transition window; an explicit degree-and-rank-only cardinality; finite-rank rather than finitely generated groups; and the exact T4/T3 threshold

degeneracy_lock.BA_closure: BA is one of the only two potentially free adjacent words and every BA branch closes at the third letter with at most d^2 initial states.
degeneracy_lock.CBA_closure: Under a=-1 and b*c^(d-1)=-1, the exceptional free CBA branch closes at the fourth letter with at most d^2 initial states.
degeneracy_lock.CB_closure: CB is one of the only two potentially free adjacent words; CBB and CBC close at the third letter, while CBA is free only if a=-1 and b*c^(d-1)=-1.
degeneracy_lock.degeneracy_total_bound: There are 3^4=81 four-letter words, each with at most d^2 initial states, hence at most 81*d^2 fully degenerate initial states.
degeneracy_lock.indexing_direction: The first letter labels the recurrence at i, the second at i+1, the third at i+2, and the fourth at i+3.
degeneracy_lock.simultaneous_degeneracy: At each degenerate index choose any valid label; pairwise overlaps may be multiply counted but cannot be missed, and triple degeneracy is impossible in characteristic zero.

proof_dependency_lock.nondegenerate_bound: exp(18^9*(3*r+1)) triples at each local index and at most d local states per triple, hence at most 4*d*exp(18^9*(3*r+1)) initial states with a nondegenerate local equation

safe_title: Four-Step Escape from Finite-Rank Tori for Monomial Henon Maps

theorem_lock.T_m_definition: T_m(H,Gamma)={P in Gamma^2: H^j(P) is in Gamma^2 for every integer j with 0<=j<=m}
theorem_lock.field: K is an arbitrary field of characteristic zero
theorem_lock.finite_rank_group: Gamma<=K^* has finite rank r; finite generation is not assumed
theorem_lock.periodic_corollary: If C_n^Gamma(H) counts exact-period-n H-orbits O with the whole orbit O contained in Gamma^2, then sum_(n>=1) n*C_n^Gamma(H)<=4*d*exp(18^9*(3*r+1))+81*d^2.

rank_one_T3_sharpness.statement: For every integer d>=2 there is a rank-one Gamma with infinitely many P_t in T_3(H,Gamma).

theorem_lock.window_semantics: T_4 has five states and four transitions/local equations; T_3 has four states and three transitions.
